name: llama-vulkan-r9700
description: Upstream ggml-org official Vulkan llama.cpp build, mirrored on the 9700x8 box (x86_64). Runs on AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (gfx1201) via mesa RADV (units pass VK_DRIVER_FILES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/radeon_icd.x86_64.json). Same upstream image as llama-vulkan-halo; Vulkan is vendor-agnostic.
